messages:
maria: Quick question — running into odd behavior with async function-calling + structured output in the Python SDK. My sampleapp expects a dataclass but I get a dict back.

maria: Minimal repro (async):
```python
from dataclasses import dataclass

@dataclass
class Book:
    title: str
    author: str

resp = await client.fn_call(
    name="get_book",
    input={"isbn": "9780143126560"},
    response_schema=Book,
)
print(type(resp))  # -> <class 'dict'> (expected Book)
```

sam: ugh. is that with the latest 0.19.x wheel or the local editable install?

maria: wheel from pip (0.19.2). I tried editable too, same behavior. The sync helper coercion works fine: `client.fn_call_sync(..., response_schema=Book)` returns a Book instance.

leo: sounds like the async path skips the dataclass coercer. we had a recent refactor to unify tool/fncall pipelines, maybe a missing await or different code path for response postprocessing.

sam: can you paste the raw response body (or at least the shape)? might be getting returned already parsed as dict then returned directly. also, does your `response_schema` support both pydantic and plain dataclass?

maria: raw body looks like `{"title": "Sapiens", "author": "Y. Harari"}`. I passed a plain dataclass (no pydantic). the sync flow converts that dict -> dataclass via the helper in devex/sdk/python client coercion module. async path seems to return the parsed json without coercion.

anya: iirc we had an explicit call to `coerce_response_to_schema(...)` in the sync `fn_call` wrapper but the async wrapper uses `await stream_or_single(...)` and then short-circuits. @sam might know where that changed.

sam: yep — commit 8f3b7d6 (tooling-unify-stream) moved some logic. i think the coercion ended up behind a sync-only branch. quick fix: ensure postprocess step runs after `await` in async fncall. i'll take a look.

ci-bot: :warning: build failed on branch devex/async-fncall-coerce-fix — failing tests: tests/test_fncall_coercion.py::test_async_dataclass_coercion

maria: thanks — created an issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-py/issues/487 (async fn_call ignores dataclass response_schema). opened a draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-py/pull/489

sam: assigned. quick checklist: add unit test for dataclass and pydantic model in async and sync flows, add regression note, and verify retry/backoff doesn't re-run coercion multiple times. retries should only re-attempt the network call, coercion happens after final response.

leo: also watch for auth header propagation in the unified wrapper — we recently had a bug where a token was refreshed but not passed to a replayed request. not directly related but good to validate (auth + retries + coercion interplay).

anya: small UX ask for sampleapp: can we include a tiny section in sampleapp/README.md showing both sync and async fn_call examples with dataclass and pydantic schema? onboarding hit for new users when behavior differs.

maria: will add docs + sampleapp test vectors. i'll also add a tiny e2e in CI that runs the sampleapp example (fast, mocked) so we catch regressions.

sam: thanks — i'll review the PR today. once merged, we'll cut a patch release 0.19.3 and update the sampleapp dependencies in the onboarding guide. :thumbsup:

maria: awesome — appreciate the fast triage.

leo: FYI, if you need a quick hotfix branch for a customer test, ping me and i can backport.

maria: will do. closing the loop here after PR lands and I update the sampleapp docs.
